text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I'm Mayano Top Gun. Nice to meet you, 
Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya wants to become a sparkling adult! An 
adult Umamusume who makes everyone's heart 
skip a beat.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer-chan, make sure to watch Maya 
closely, okay? ♪

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
